newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Debate on Argentine bank privatisation delayed.
newsitem.headline: Debate on Argentine bank privatisation delayed.

text.p: The debate in the Argentine Congress' lower house on the privatisation of state mortgage lender Banco Hipotecario Nacional was delayed late on Tuesday after a row erupted on the hotly contested issue.
The row started when opposition parties opposing the sale accused the ruling Peronist Party of being authoritarian.
They said the Peronist Party had insisted on waiting for more than two hours in anticipation of quorum being reached in the chamber, state news agency Telam reported.
Opponents fear the bank's privatisation could end its role in providing accessible home loans.
The $3.0 billion expected to be made from the sale will be used to finance public works including credits for the construction of new housing.
